app.label: QR code for the authenticator app
app.description:
Open the Authenticator app on your phone, add an account by scanning the QR code above, and enter the code generated by the app to confirm that setup is complete.
You can use Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator, available on the App Store (iOS) or Play Store (Android).

sms.label: Phone number
sms.description:
Enter your phone number, click 'Send OTP', and enter the OTP code received on your phone to verify.
The OTP code is valid for 5 minutes. After that, click 'Send OTP' again to have the system resend the OTP code to your phone.
